description:
### ✨ PixelBoard Patches (v1.0.2)

* **Gemini Rambler Voice Typing**: Auto-cleanup, sentence restructuring, and auto-punctuation
* **In-Line AI Writing Assistant**: Proofread, rephrase, and tone switcher
* **Google Signature Bypass**: Bypass signature whitelist checks
* **Standalone Coexistence**: Side-by-side installation with stock Gboard

Supports Gboard v18.0.3 (Stable) & v18.3.1 (Beta).

patches.name: AI Writing Tools
patches.description: Enable AI writing tools with support for all languages.

patches.name: Add Gboard Signature Bypass
patches.description: Bypass Gboard signature whitelist checks and force them to pass.

patches.name: Advanced Voice Typing
patches.description: Enable Advanced Voice Typing with automatic punctuation and rambler mode.

patches.name: Package Rename
patches.description: Rename the package to com.akshaykadam.pixelboard and allow a custom app name so it can be installed alongside the official Gboard.
